=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "TMR-PARAM", "section": "1. Parameters", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "The block works for every `W` from 4 to 32, and bits `W` and up of the `LOAD` and `COUNT` registers read as zero; a write to `LOAD` ignores them."},
    {"id": "TMR-RESET", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `CTRL`, `LOAD`, `COUNT` and `STATUS` clear to zero."},
    {"id": "TMR-REG-RW", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` stores `wdata` bits 2 to 0 in it, and a write to `LOAD` stores `wdata` bits `W-1` to 0 in it."},
    {"id": "TMR-READ", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "TMR-START", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where a write to `CTRL` sets `EN` and `EN` was 0, the count loads the `LOAD` value."},
    {"id": "TMR-COUNT", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is not zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the count falls by one."},
    {"id": "TMR-WRITE-WINS", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` takes the place of that edge's count step: at that edge the count does not fall and the timer does not expire, whatever the count was."},
    {"id": "TMR-STOP", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` that clears `EN` stops the timer and the count keeps its value."},
    {"id": "TMR-LOAD-LATE", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `LOAD` does not change the count: the new value is used at the next start or periodic reload."},
    {"id": "TMR-EXPIRE", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the timer expires: `EXPIRED` is set."},
    {"id": "TMR-PERIODIC", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In periodic mode an expiry also loads the count with the `LOAD` value, and `EN` stays 1."},
    {"id": "TMR-ONESHOT", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In one-shot mode an expiry also clears `EN`, and the count stays zero until the next start."},
    {"id": "TMR-W1C", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `STATUS` with bit 0 set clears `EXPIRED`, and with bit 0 clear changes nothing; it never sets the flag."},
    {"id": "TMR-SET-WINS", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A timer that expires at the same rising edge as a write that clears `EXPIRED` keeps `EXPIRED` set."},
    {"id": "TMR-IRQ", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when `EXPIRED` and `IE` are both 1, in one-shot and periodic mode alike; it follows the registers with no clock edge."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-param-width", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_param_width", "proves": ["TMR-PARAM"], "rationale": "Build at W=4, 16 and 32. Write all-ones to LOAD, then check that LOAD and COUNT (after a start) read with bits W and up equal to zero and bits W-1..0 equal to the written value. Run a short one-shot countdown at each W to show the block works."},
    {"id": "T-reset", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_reset", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "Drive every register to a nonzero value: enable, load, count running, EXPIRED set. Then hold rst_n low for one edge, check that CTRL, LOAD, COUNT and STATUS all read zero, and check that irq is low as a result."},
    {"id": "T-reset-during-write", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_reset_with_write", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "Assert rst_n low at the same edge as a write to CTRL and to LOAD. Check that the registers read zero after that edge."},
    {"id": "T-reg-rw", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_reg_rw", "proves": ["TMR-REG-RW"], "rationale": "Write random and walking-ones wdata to CTRL and LOAD. Check that CTRL reads back wdata[2:0] with its upper bits zero, and that LOAD reads back wdata[W-1:0]."},
    {"id": "T-count-ro", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_count_write_ignored", "proves": ["TMR-REG-RW", "TMR-READ"], "rationale": "Write to COUNT while the timer is stopped and while it is running. Check that the count is unchanged by the write and keeps its normal stepping."},
    {"id": "T-read-no-side-effect", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_read_no_side_effect", "proves": ["TMR-READ"], "rationale": "With EXPIRED set and the timer running, sweep addr over all four registers without writing. Check that no register changes, and in particular that STATUS is not cleared by a read."},
    {"id": "T-read-comb", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_read_comb", "proves": ["TMR-READ"], "rationale": "Change addr between clock edges and sample rdata before the next edge. Check that it already shows the newly selected register."},
    {"id": "T-start", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_start", "proves": ["TMR-START"], "rationale": "With EN=0 and LOAD=N, write CTRL with EN=1. Check that COUNT reads N right after that edge. Repeat with N=0, N=1 and N=max."},
    {"id": "T-start-already-en", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_start_when_running", "proves": ["TMR-START", "TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "While the timer is running (EN=1), write CTRL again with EN=1. Check that the count neither reloads nor steps at that edge."},
    {"id": "T-count", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_count_down", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT"], "rationale": "Start with LOAD=N and check that COUNT decrements by exactly one per edge until zero. Writes to LOAD and STATUS during counting must not stop the stepping."},
    {"id": "T-write-wins", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_ctrl_write_wins", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "Write CTRL (keeping EN=1) at an edge where the count is nonzero, and check that the count does not fall. Write CTRL at an edge where the count is zero, and check that EXPIRED is not set at that edge."},
    {"id": "T-stop", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_stop", "proves": ["TMR-STOP"], "rationale": "Clear EN mid-count and check that COUNT holds its value over many edges. Then restart and check that the count reloads from LOAD per TMR-START."},
    {"id": "T-load-late", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_load_late", "proves": ["TMR-LOAD-LATE"], "rationale": "Write a new LOAD value mid-count and check that the count is unchanged. Check that the next start (one-shot) and the next periodic reload use the new value."},
    {"id": "T-expire", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_expire", "proves": ["TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "Check that EXPIRED sets exactly at the edge after COUNT reads zero with EN=1, and not earlier. Include LOAD=0, which expires at the first edge after the start."},
    {"id": "T-periodic", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_periodic", "proves": ["TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "In periodic mode, check that at each expiry COUNT reloads LOAD and EN stays 1. Check that the period is LOAD+1 edges over several periods."},
    {"id": "T-oneshot", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_oneshot", "proves": ["TMR-ONESHOT", "TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "In one-shot mode, check that expiry clears EN in CTRL and that COUNT stays zero until a new start. Check that EXPIRED is not set again while stopped."},
    {"id": "T-w1c", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_status_w1c", "proves": ["TMR-W1C"], "rationale": "With EXPIRED set, write STATUS bit0=0 and check that the flag stays set, then write bit0=1 and check that it clears. With EXPIRED clear, write bit0=1 and check that it stays clear, which shows a write never sets the flag."},
    {"id": "T-set-wins", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_expire_clear_collision", "proves": ["TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Time a STATUS write with bit0=1 to land on the expiry edge in both modes. Check that EXPIRED reads 1 after that edge."},
    {"id": "T-irq", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "test_irq", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Sweep IE and EXPIRED in both modes, toggling IE by a CTRL write and clearing the flag by W1C. Check irq against EXPIRED&&IE, sampled before the next edge."},
    {"id": "A-reset", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_reset_clears", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "Asserts that whenever rst_n is low at an edge, all four registers are zero after it."},
    {"id": "A-count-step", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_count_step", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT", "TMR-STOP"], "rationale": "If EN && count!=0 && !ctrl_write then the next count is count-1. If !EN && !ctrl_write then the count is stable."},
    {"id": "A-write-wins", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_ctrl_write_no_step", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "On a CTRL write, the count does not decrement and EXPIRED does not rise at that edge."},
    {"id": "A-start", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_start_loads", "proves": ["TMR-START", "TMR-LOAD-LATE"], "rationale": "A CTRL write setting EN with EN previously 0 makes the next count equal LOAD. A LOAD write alone never changes the count."},
    {"id": "A-expire", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_expire", "proves": ["TMR-EXPIRE", "TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-ONESHOT"], "rationale": "EN && count==0 && !ctrl_write implies that EXPIRED is set next. In periodic mode the next count is LOAD and EN stays 1. In one-shot mode EN clears and the count stays 0."},
    {"id": "A-flag", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_flag_rules", "proves": ["TMR-W1C", "TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "EXPIRED rises only on an expiry, never from a write. It falls only on a STATUS write with bit0=1 at an edge without an expiry."},
    {"id": "A-irq", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_comb", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "An immediate assertion that irq == (EXPIRED && IE) at all times."},
    {"id": "A-upper-zero", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_upper_bits_zero", "proves": ["TMR-PARAM", "TMR-REG-RW"], "rationale": "The unused CTRL bits, STATUS bits above bit 0, and LOAD/COUNT bits W and up always read zero on rdata."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===
